ns2:section.sectionText: *You must also simultaneously register for a lab section, either JOUR 220 AB1 67466 or AB2 67467. Students who have completed JOUR 320 should not register for JOUR 220. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.
